_note: Voiceover for the TradingQuiz SPY cup-and-handle zoom reel. The FIRST cut of this script ran 74.7s against a 36s reel, so the picture is now derived from the measured audio instead of the other way round: synthesise, measure, then size each act to what was actually said. Keep lines short — every extra clause costs a second of reel.

segments.text: Real S P Y daily bars, printing live.
Watch what happens when we pull back.
Ten tests of that same line. That is what makes it a level.
And price just closed back above it. Five seconds. What happens next?
Buy. Entry is the close that reclaimed the rim.
The stop goes under the handle. If price drops back into the cup, the setup failed. That is eight dollars of risk.
The target comes from the risk, not from hope. One to two means you aim sixteen for the eight you put up.
Target hit. Plus three point seven percent.
Only one in six of these ever got there. A reason, not a promise.
Like and follow for more setups.
